kingfisher.arrival: Gold/green corner plaques and framed villa view; right booking column, inset caption and vertical image controls.
kingfisher.later: Suite dossier: description, information links and separate rate rail; light inset detail panels.
kingfisher.mobile: Photograph and inset caption, then booking; the suite information follows. Rate rail stacks below the description.

kwafubesi.arrival: Preserved canvas panorama, field-note caption and planning bench; image controls use dashed 56×44 index capsules.
kwafubesi.later: Sequential room blocks and a broad rate/action band; dashed section dividers and stacked map/facts.
kwafubesi.mobile: Photograph, camp introduction, then booking. Room options and rates become sequential sections.
kwafubesi.background: Very subtle canvas-like horizontal line texture.

hoyo-hoyo.arrival: Preserved warm architectural welcome; circular 52px image controls and rounded screen-navigation targets.
hoyo-hoyo.later: Strong property/section headers, accent rail, segmented detail links and paired policy blocks.
hoyo-hoyo.mobile: Photograph then booking and welcome copy; segmented information links wrap while preserving every control.
hoyo-hoyo.background: Warm surface with a narrow burnt-orange edge.

hamiltons.arrival: Preserved itinerary/folio direction; double-rule square image controls and restrained heritage navigation; caption excludes the control gutter.
hamiltons.later: Room/tariff ledger, fine double rules, paired policy columns and framed map/photo plates.
hamiltons.mobile: Planning form precedes the photograph; rates move below room descriptions with the ledger grid scrollable inside its panel.

imbali.arrival: Darker joined control strip and booking tone; hero, booking and intro edges align, with top-aligned desktop booking groups and separate CTA row.
imbali.later: Broad information and rate bands, large native progression text, dark picture mat and adjacent map/facts zones.
imbali.mobile: Photograph and integrated shelf, then dark booking block; light fields and broad room/rate bands stack clearly.
imbali.background: Plain warm stone surface around dark photographic/booking sections.
